---
title: "After the course"
---
By the end of stage 12 you hold four case reports, each with a reproduction, an estimand statement and its causal graph, and a specification declared before it ran, and a project in a repository that another person can clone and re-render. The route took from each module of the [companion curriculum](../../companion/index.qmd) the sections that its cases needed and left several out, and the table below lists them. Each module stands on its own and names at its top the cases on which it works, so take the one that your own work needs and leave the rest. The section "Going further" at the end of each case report also holds exercises that run in its workspace, among them a sweep of a whole decision, the five analysts placed on the curve, the checks that the curve leaves out, and the replications with new data.

| If you want | Read |
|---|---|
| R further on: other file formats and fetching data from an archive, the three dialects in which R is written, the grammar of graphics, the specification curve, and the habit of naming the estimand before a model is read | [Getting started with R](../../companion/intro-r.qmd), from [Other formats, and fetching data](../../companion/intro-r.qmd#sec-formats) to [Naming the estimand](../../companion/intro-r.qmd#sec-easystats) |
| The other estimators of the course: survey weights in a panel of cells, the same model stated as a posterior, and an outcome bounded between 0 and 1 | [Survey weights](../../companion/stats-methods.qmd#sec-weights), [Bayesian estimation](../../companion/stats-methods.qmd#sec-bayes) and [Bounded outcomes](../../companion/stats-methods.qmd#sec-glm) in the statistical methods module |
| Results from different estimators and outcome scales put on one axis, the conversion behind the comparisons of Multi100 | [A common scale](../../companion/stats-methods.qmd#sec-onescale) in the statistical methods module, and [cross-analyst comparisons](../../cases/eu-frames/index.qmd#sec-back) in the case study of the EU-frames case |
| A survey item as the outcome of a model, with clustered data, an interaction and a random intercept | [The section on the EU-frames case](../../companion/binary-outcomes.qmd#sec-eu-frames) in the binary-outcomes module |
| What no statistic computed from the data can settle about a causal graph, and a graph for a question of your own | [Graphs and data](../../companion/dags.qmd#sec-quartet) and [Your own graph](../../companion/dags.qmd#sec-yours) in the module on causal graphs |
| The items, dimensions and reliability of the battery behind the outcomes of the EU-frames case | [The items behind the scales](../../companion/measurement.qmd), from [The instrument](../../companion/measurement.qmd#sec-instrument) to [The outcome on the curve](../../companion/measurement.qmd#sec-curve-outcome) |
| The cell weights of the EU-frames panel, and the population weight as another estimand | [Weights](../../companion/weighting.qmd#sec-eu-frames), the section on the EU-frames case |
| The claim at the level of respondents, and what individual circumstances can and cannot say about a national context | [The individual level](../../companion/individual-level.qmd) |
| Data with a known recipe, a world with no effect in it, and a design tested before it is run | [Simulation as a method](../../companion/simulation.qmd) |
| Where else data for a question of your own are held, the access rule of each source, and how to cite a dataset | [The map](../../companion/data-sources.qmd#sec-map) and [Citing data](../../companion/data-sources.qmd#sec-citing) in the data-sources module |
| The macro series of the EU-frames panel at their sources | [The macro indicators, at the World Bank](../../companion/data-sources.qmd#sec-worldbank) and [The published series](../../companion/data-sources.qmd#sec-series) in the data-sources module |
| The SCORE dossiers read as records, the OSF after 2026, and a record found from the paper alone | [The SCORE dossier of the housing-audit case](../../companion/repositories.qmd#sec-trail), [the SCORE dossier of the EU-frames case](../../companion/repositories.qmd#sec-trail-eu-frames), [The OSF after 2026](../../companion/repositories.qmd#sec-osf) and [Finding the record](../../companion/repositories.qmd#sec-exercise) in the repositories module |
| The deposits behind the four cases | The package of the housing-audit study on the Harvard Dataverse, [doi:10.7910/DVN/1HOVTU](https://doi.org/10.7910/DVN/1HOVTU), and the data of its replication at [osf.io/xseqg](https://osf.io/xseqg/); the dossiers listed in section 2 of the case studies of the [immigration-and-trust](../../cases/trust/index.qmd#sec-score) and [cohabitation](../../cases/cohabitation/index.qmd#sec-score) cases; and the panel of the EU-frames case in the OSF component that its analyst maintains, [osf.io/6zqct](https://osf.io/6zqct/) |
| A replication of the EU-frames claim on later Eurobarometer waves | Not taught on this site: the data would be built from the files at GESIS by the route of stage 10, and [section 2.1 of the case study](../../cases/eu-frames/index.qmd#sec-repetition) of the EU-frames case reports what the SCORE replication on the waves of 2013 to 2019 found |

The formats with a facilitator take one case each, and suit anyone who wants to work through a case with others rather than alone. The housing-audit case is taught in a [short session](../housing-short/index.qmd) in the browser and in one-day workshops on [open science](../housing-one-day-open-science/index.qmd), [data tools](../housing-one-day-data-tools/index.qmd) and [methods](../housing-one-day-methods/index.qmd). The EU-frames case is taught in one-day workshops on its country-year panel, on [open science](../eu-frames-one-day-open-science/index.qmd), [data tools](../eu-frames-one-day-data-tools/index.qmd) and [methods](../eu-frames-one-day-methods/index.qmd). The three-day courses on the [immigration-and-trust](../trust-three-days/index.qmd), [cohabitation](../cohabitation-three-days/index.qmd) and [EU-frames](../eu-frames-three-days/index.qmd) cases start from the raw surveys and build the analysis file of the case in class, a step that the route takes only for the EU-frames case.
